body:
I can confirm that the bug exists, this fix is correct, and I tested that it works for the intended use cases. Thanks! This was a mistake on my part, I forgot to test indirect descendant scripts when I wrote this function, and this PR fixes it.

I forget how heavy the 4.5 feature freeze is, if bug fixes are allowed or only regression fixes, but I can confirm this is good for sure. But also, it's non-vital and an edge case.
